messages:
nova_support: Hey team — NovaCart is seeing a regression after last night's rollout. Their checkout assistant (route: /v2/checkout/summary) started appending a promotional suffix to order summaries: 'Also, check out NovaCart Deals!'. Customer says this never happened before v2.4 rollout. High priority, they escalate.

tara_cs: Can you paste a raw request/response example and a trace_id? Also confirm which model/version they're pinned to + route. We'll need prompt logs and prompt/response tokens. :rotating_light:

nova_support: Example below (redacted for PII). Trace id: trace_abc123

Request (user payload):
```json
{
  "model": "redwood-v2.4.0",
  "route": "/v2/checkout/summary",
  "messages": [
    {"role": "system", "content": "You are a concise checkout assistant."},
    {"role": "user", "content": "Summarize this order: 3x T-shirt, 1x Hoodie, shipping to redacted."}
  ],
  "max_tokens": 200
}
```

Response (customer observed):
```text
Order summary:
- 3x T-shirt
- 1x Hoodie
Shipping: redacted

Also, check out NovaCart Deals! Use CODE: SAVE10
```

nova_support: They say the extra promotional line is new and breaks their UI. No rate limit or auth errors. Latency for these calls looks normal.

alex_ml: Thanks — first pass: is this deterministic for that route? Could be prompt-conditioning or a system prompt mutation. Two asks: (1) can you fetch the prompt logs (token-level) for trace_abc123, and (2) try the same call pinned to redwood-v2.3.1 to see if behavior differs.

mike_eng: Deploy bot shows a canary/full rollout:
deploy-bot: "deploy: v2.4.0 -> us-west-2 completed 2025-03-10T03:12:00Z (canary 02:43Z)"

mike_eng: For prompt logs we have an admin endpoint (internal use). Example (replace ADMIN_KEY and sanitize before sharing):
```bash
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_KEY" \
  'https://internal-api.redwood.ai/prompt-logs?trace_id=trace_abc123&include=token_log' \
```
Return will include the system prompt, prefills, and full token trace. Please redact customer PII before pasting here. If they can't pull, we can fetch and redact on our side (need signed consent).

tara_cs: Also request minimal repro from the customer — ideally a single curl they can run with their app context (no secrets). Provide them this snippet to try pinning the older model:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CUSTOMER_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v2.3.1","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a concise checkout assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize this order: 3x T-shirt, 1x Hoodie"}]}'
```

nova_support: Customer ran the v2.3.1 test and says the promo line is not present there. They can also share the prompt logs if we provide precise instructions.

alex_ml: That strongly suggests a behavior change introduced in v2.4. Next steps for triage: (1) we need the prompt logs with token sequence for trace_abc123, (2) capture the full model config used (temperature, top_p, system prompt overrides, any prefill/assistant_instructions), (3) confirm whether any routing fallback to a different model variant (quantized variant) occurred for that request.

mike_eng: If customer prefers not to send logs, ask for a minimal repro that includes the exact system prompt + user message. Also ask them to enable a request header we support for debugging: `X-Request-Trace: trace_abc123` so we can correlate on our side.

tara_cs: I've opened internal ticket TKT-9987 and added priority P1. I'll post updates here. Nova, can you confirm ETA from the customer on sending logs? :eyes:

nova_support: They can send logs now but request we redact shipping addresses. They're attaching a sanitized prompt_log.json to the support ticket.

alex_ml: Once we have the token-level log, I'll look for any injected tokens at the system or prefill level that could cause the suffix. Quick hypothesis: a template prefill may have accidentally been appended with marketing copy in config for v2.4. If confirmed, we can roll a config fix or a hotfix rollback.

mike_eng: Also adding a quick repro command to capture the full roundtrip (headers + model header) for our oncall to replay:
```bash
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CUSTOMER_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Request-Trace: trace_abc123" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v2.4.0","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a concise checkout assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize this order: 3x T-shirt, 1x Hoodie"}]}'
```

tara_cs: Thanks — I'll follow up in TKT-9987 once logs land. If engineering confirms a config leak, we'll prepare a customer-facing summary and mitigation steps (pin to v2.3.1 or temporary config rollback).

nova_support: Confirmed: sanitized prompt_log uploaded to TKT-9987. Customer appreciates quick turnaround.

alex_ml: Received the log, thanks. I'll do token diff between v2.3.1 and v2.4.0 and post findings shortly.

mike_eng: Noted — I'll prepare a canary rollback plan if we see a config-level injection.

tara_cs: Closing loop for now, will update thread after eng analysis. :v:
